name: Agenda Intelligence MD
description: Deterministic evidence-packet linter for claim-backed AI output, with compatibility adapters and profiles.

product.name: Agenda Intelligence
product.description: Product shell exposing the analyze pipeline over the validation and reasoning layers. Routes geography to regional and sector references, assembles a system prompt from bundled SKILL.md content, and validates output against the agenda-memo contract.
product.signals_source: Global Think Tank Analyst (vendored snapshot under data/signals/)

brief_json.description: Parsed agenda brief JSON object to validate against the bundled schema.

evidence_json.description: Parsed evidence-pack JSON object to validate against the bundled schema.

packet_json.description: Claims plus the complete source texts those claims reference. Call get_schema('evidence_packet_request') for the full nested contract.

audit_json.description: Parsed claim-level evidence-audit object to validate and summarize.

name.description: Protocol document name. Use 'entrypoint' for the main Agenda-Intelligence.md.

lens_type.description: Optional filter. Use 'regional' for geography lenses or 'sector' for sector lenses.

lens_id.description: Specific lens identifier returned by list_lenses.

category.description: Source requirement category slug, for example sanctions, elections, or energy. Call list_source_categories for the full set.

evidence_json.description: Parsed evidence pack to compare against source requirements.

category.description: Optional source requirement category slug; overrides evidence_json.source_category.

before_text.description: Original analysis text before Agenda Intelligence processing.

after_text.description: Revised analysis text to score against the protocol rubric.

pack_json.description: Evidence pack (evidence IDs + quote fragments) or evidence-audit doc (claims with supporting_quotes) to check.

texts.description: Optional mapping from evidence_id to caller-provided plain source text.

request_json.description: Grounded-check request: claims (claim_id, claim_text, optional quotes) plus corpus documents (corpus_id, text).
Claim verification request. Call get_schema('claim_verification_request') for the full nested contract.

request.description: Agenda request with question, geography, audience, depth, evidence mode, and output format. Call get_schema('agenda_request') for the full nested contract.

examples.question: How exposed is a Kazakhstan-incorporated payments fintech to secondary US sanctions risk over the next 12 months?
examples.decision_context: Whether to open a USD correspondent banking relationship in Almaty in Q3.

memo_json.description: Parsed Agenda memo JSON object to validate against the output schema.
Parsed Agenda memo JSON object to check for evidence-readiness quality.

signal_id.description: Signal identifier returned by list_signals, without a file extension.

aspect.description: Optional future deep-dive aspect. Currently ignored because the tool is reserved.

deal_risk_request.description: Structured Middle Corridor deal-risk request. Call get_schema('middle_corridor_deal_risk_request') for the full nested contract.

examples.risk_question: Should this be escalated before contract signature?

exposure_request.description: Structured CIS secondary-sanctions exposure request. Call get_schema('cis_secondary_sanctions_request') for the full nested contract.

examples.risk_question: Does the disclosed ownership chain create indirect exposure under OFAC EO 14114 or EU sanctions package?

trust_request.description: Structured agentic interaction trust request. Call get_schema('agentic_interaction_trust_request') for the full nested contract.

examples.requested_action: complete purchase of two restricted-delivery items
examples.risk_question: Is this agent-mediated checkout ready to allow, step up, or route to human review?

exposure_request.description: Structured Gulf maritime exposure request. Call get_schema('gulf_maritime_exposure_request') for the full nested contract.

examples.risk_question: Is this Hormuz transit ready to fix, or should it be escalated before fixture?

readiness_request.description: Structured Kazakhstan market-entry readiness request. Call get_schema('market_entry_readiness_request') for the full nested contract.

audit_json.description: Claim-level evidence audit of the output being relayed. Call get_schema('evidence_audit') for the full nested contract.

action_request.description: Structured pre-action check request. Call get_schema('pre_action_check_request') for the full nested contract.

name.description: Schema key, file name, or bare stem. Omit to list all available schema names.

signal_classification.description: Signal class from agenda-brief.schema.json (for example signal, weak_signal, structural_shift). Call get_schema('agenda_brief') for the full enum.

what_changed.description: What is materially different now versus the prior state.

main_uncertainty.description: The premise that would most change the conclusion if false.

watch_next.description: Observable indicators to monitor next. At least one is required.

affected_actors.description: Optional list of actors materially affected.

scenarios.description: Optional scenario objects with name, description, and indicators.

signal_markers.description: Optional qualifying markers that do not replace signal_classification.

data_integrity_notes.description: Optional surfaced concerns about prompt injection, source anomalies, or retrieval limits. Records a concern; it is not an automated trust verdict.

evidence_mode.description: How the brief was sourced. Defaults to reasoning_only; set explicitly when sources were actually supplied.

confidence.description: Optional confidence as a level string or a level/score/reasoning object.

claim.description: Claim text to add, or the exact text of an existing claim to extend.

pack_json.description: Existing evidence-pack object to extend. Omit to create a new pack from topic.

topic.description: Pack topic. Required only when pack_json is omitted.

sources.description: Source objects matching evidence-pack.schema.json: name, source_type, freshness, supports, limits, and optional url.

support_status.description: Analyst judgement of claim support. Omit to take the conservative default; pass it explicitly to upgrade a claim or to change an existing one.

evidence_mode.description: How the pack was sourced. Defaults to reasoning_only for a new pack; when supplied it overwrites the value on an existing pack.
